description: Formerly databases and SaaS, now mostly AI infrastructure: data centers, cloud, and the database underneath.
reasons: Estimates rose over the last 30 days while the stock fell more than 20% this year, so the market is pricing a decline the analysts do not see.
It trades at 13.4x next year's earnings against Google on 23.2x, so the AI backlog is not priced in.
Snowflake trades at 21x sales for software and data without the infrastructure; Oracle has all three at 6x sales.
The market is overpricing GPU depreciation and the debt behind the buildout, since both are already visible in guidance.

quants.eps_trend: slightly up over the last 7 days
quants.eps_revisions: all up, with 4 up and 0 down over 30 days
extra: Last reported quarter: net income +11% quarter over quarter, EPS 1.47 -> 1.92 year over year

structuring.thesis_target: Targeting the 10-Dec-26 report gives the backlog conversion one quarter to show up.
structuring.reflection: Credit is 23.2% mid, 22.6% if priced against me, so halving it still clears the 10% floor. The short dies before the December report, so it decays without event risk.
